meaning: Python passes self.quant_cfg.expert_group_size into Rust engine.load
Rust load path only detects effective group size for prequantized models before cache lookup
For this BF16-source Nano model, cache_gs falls back to requested group_size 128
Startup cache lookup uses cache_path_marlin(model_dir, cache_gs, ...)
If requested-path cache is absent, startup enters the build path
Builder begins with requested group_size and computes an effective group size
Builder halves non-divisible group sizes until model dimensions divide
Completed cache is renamed to the effective group-size path
cache_path_marlin encodes group size in the filename
